concert was one of the absolute last concerts were we played the songs from our last album. We have now taken a break from playing live to record our new double album and build the Marble Machine X. While we are in the studio/workshop doing that we thought we should share this last concert with you since its going to be a while before we are on stage again. 

For the next tour we will make sure to book shows worldwide and we will bring the Marble Machine X and we are already looking forward to that, so hope to see you there and then and for now, enjoy this concert!
